content.text: Before removing this mod from your load order, you must click the button below to flush the active queue and safely unhook the plugin from the engine.

content.help: Seals the Engine hook and flushes the swap queue. A notification will appear in the top left when it is safe to save and exit.

content.text: If you have edited your INI rules and want them to apply to actors that have already been processed in this save, click below to clear the processed-actors cache. All visible actors will be re-evaluated against the current ruleset on their next load.

content.help: Wipes the list of already-evaluated actors so every actor is re-checked against the current rules on next load. Safe to use anytime except during uninstall.

content.text: Iterating on INI rules? Click below to re-parse every INI file under Data\F4SE\Plugins\BaseNPCSwapper without restarting the game. New OMODs are scanned incrementally so the reload is fast (typically under a second). The pipeline pauses while reloading, then resumes; every visible actor re-evaluates on its next load.

content.help: Re-parses the INI rule files, incrementally updates the OMOD cache, and resumes the pipeline. Use after editing rules so changes take effect without a game restart.
